How it works

Light travels from the colored sky regions to the observer at 20 M. The turn controls group paths by how far they wind around the black hole. Click a path to inspect it.

Observer’s view and scene details

This is a coordinate drawing. Playback follows distance along the displayed paths. In Kerr, the dashed circles mark equatorial photon orbits.
